description: 실제 회사자료가 아닌 독립 Excel→Python 업무이관 시험. 원본 VBA 실행 동등성은 미검증.
oracle_method: Node JS integer rounding independently from formula evaluator and migrated Python. Expected records retained to compare identifiers, types and values, not only totals.
limitations: No actual VBA embedded or executed. Separate .bas examples are supplied by the migration prototype.
No native Excel recalculation performed. Artifact calculation and saved OOXML independently checked.
Exception previews show explicit placeholders before intentional exception formulas are inserted.
Excel serial dates are legitimate input; JSON expected dates are ISO day strings.
